rationale: xgb_adv_val structurally novel (first feature-distribution-aware reweighting trainer) and default-HP avg_ann +24.4% materially beats every prior 3/7 baseline (#570 quarterly_dro +3.5%, #539 mixup +3.3%); W2 hit unprecedented +162.6% ann. Failure modes are HP-tunable (W1 n=17 at thr=0.55 close to passing, W4 n=15 at thr=0.50 with WR=40%) — score distribution too peaky at default. Sweep should explore adv_alpha (never sampled, range [0,3]) × adv_test_frac × lower learning_rate to spread the score distribution into the threshold-sweep band.
